# Dependencies

OKF Workspace is an independent adapter, not an official release of OKF MCP.

- @copperbox/okf-mcp 2.1.0 — https://github.com/copperbox/okf-mcp — ISC.
- @modelcontextprotocol/sdk — https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk — MIT.
- TypeScript, Zod, YAML, diff, unified, remark-parse, zod-to-json-schema and tsx
  are installed through npm; see their installed LICENSE files for notices.

Upstream source/node_modules are not bundled. Exact dependency resolution is
recorded in package-lock.json. No upstream OKF source changes are included.
